name: Apophis changes its orbit (2029)
description: Apophis seen around the Sun, a year either side of its 2029 flyby (JPL's state at closest approach, moved to the Sun). Before, its orbit lies mostly inside the Earth's (a = 0.92 au, a year of 0.89 Earth years); the Earth's pull during the flyby stretches it to a = 1.10 au, mostly outside. Compare the orbit at the start and at the end in the Flight panel: JPL's values agree to the third decimal.
